grade.message: I'm writing on behalf of my dad, Harold, he's 75 and it was his first Uber. He booked a short ride (UBF07A) and the driver messaged almost straight away that he wasn't coming. I tried to get the driver to cancel but he couldn't work out how. Dad gave up and took a Lyft instead, which was fine. Then Uber charged him for the ride he never took. We've called Uber several times and got nowhere, so yesterday Dad also rang his card company about it. His email is harold.brooks07@example.com and the card ends 6407. Can you get that charge reversed?
